prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for specific change types, as only one test has been run so far for both sign-in reordering (sign_in, reorder) and waiting step callouts (home, wait_info).
Predictions were consistently too high compared to noise-corrected measured outcomes.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- home, wait_info: +1.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +3.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.0%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 18.6%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_flow] Preset fallback on photo upload screen: Add a instant preset fallback option directly inside the custom photo upload step if generation is not desired. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 60.9% and custom generation errors cause support tickets.)
1: [choose_path, copy] Clear onboarding intro story narrative: Update the initial story screen copy to clearly explain what a desktop pet is and how onboarding works. (why: The initial conversion drop at choose_path (76.2%) suggests users lack context on what they are building.)
2: [adoption, hint] Photo quality guidance hint: Add helpful criteria hints on photo requirements to prevent custom pet generation failures. (why: Multiple support emails cite custom pet creation failing or looking wrong.)
3: [home, notification] Ready notification toggle on wait screen: Offer an option to notify the user when pet generation completes so they can freely minimize the app. (why: The waiting step has a long mean duration (2336s), causing drop-off while users wait passively.)
4: [finish, layout] Two-column desktop command layout: Change home_intro layout to a two-column display detailing pet interactions on one side and final launch on the other. (why: Support logs show high confusion regarding how to summon, control, and dismiss desktop pets after setup.)
5: [home, wait_info] Interactive tip carousel during setup wait: Add a tip carousel on the waiting screen demonstrating desktop pet features while rendering occurs. (why: Addresses high waiting step idle time and solves post-onboarding user confusion about pet capabilities.)
